ops.title: JJ_CONFIG is a RELATIVE path (.claude/jj-config.toml) in cc-pool shells — jj must run from the repo root or identity silently vanishes
ops.body:
In cc-pool dev shells, `JJ_CONFIG=.claude/jj-config.toml` (relative). The Bash tool's working directory persists across calls, so after `cd widget && xcodebuild …`, a later `jj commit` resolves JJ_CONFIG against `widget/`, finds nothing, and commits with an EMPTY identity — `jj git push` then rejects with "no author and/or committer set".

**Why:** jj resolves a relative JJ_CONFIG against the process cwd, not the repo root; the failure is silent at commit time (only a warning) and hard-fails at push.

**How to apply:** Always run jj from `/Users/yasyf/Code/claude-pool` (prefix commands with `cd /Users/yasyf/Code/claude-pool &&`). To repair a half-identified commit: if only the committer is empty, `jj metaedit -r <change> --update-author-timestamp` forces a rewrite that re-stamps the committer (jj 0.42: `jj describe --reset-author` does not exist; author fixes go through `jj metaedit --update-author` / `--author`).
